verdict.rationale: The quickstart describes a `/upload` slash command used during a session, and says you can "also" chat via the Web UI. Together these imply an interactive chat in the terminal by default, and a community user praises the "CLI interface" UX. Separately, the `--cli` flag gives a terminal mode that answers a supplied prompt. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party description of the interactive terminal chat mode (launch, multi-turn behavior, available commands), and independent hands-on detail of a terminal chat session.
